answer: Split-tally bond stops mass fakes. Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, filing a terrace claim. A crystal seal splits in two halves. First fake 38, the k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38 once; a rented-half ring fails, halves never tally.
